snippet.title: Agefield High: Rock the School - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562580/Agefield_High_Rock_the_School/

Agefield High: Rock the School is an open-world coming-of-age adventure about friendship, love, and rebellion, inspired by the raunchy teen comedies of the early 2000s. 

Agefield High: Rock the School releases Summer 2026 on Steam! Follow our socials to stay updated!
